items.title: What makes AI agent runtime logs defensible under adversarial audit?
items.raw_excerpt: Modern AI agents can execute tools, write to databases, and trigger irreversible actions. Most teams rely on traditional logging (OpenTelemetry, SIEM, DB audit logs). items.raw_excerpt:
